task: Fix blank prev/next/jump/bookmark chapter-nav icons: lucide svg children of .chapter-workspace-header__nav-btn collapsed to 0 width inside the inline-flex button, same root cause already fixed once for .player-btn svg but never applied here. User-reported live regression, caught by direct DOM inspection (svg boundingClientRect width:0) after a screenshot showed empty pill buttons.

frontend/src/theme/components.css.summary: Added '.chapter-workspace-header__nav-btn svg { flex-shrink: 0; }' mirroring the existing documented fix for .player-btn svg, pinning lucide icons to their intrinsic size instead of letting the inline-flex main-axis algorithm collapse them to 0 width.

flow_impact: none — visual-only fix, no behavior/contract change. Verified live: all 4 previously-blank buttons (Previous chapter, Next chapter, Jump to next unrendered chapter, Bookmark this chapter) now render their icons; 165/165 frontend/tests/unit/pages/Book/ tests still pass.
